slides.title: The circuit has headroom
slides.body:
And the complaint is still real.
Both are true at once.

slides.title: Something has to wait
slides.body:
When the link is momentarily full, one packet goes first.
That's all queuing *is*.

slides.title: If you don't decide, the device does
slides.body: Its default is roughly first come, first served.

slides.title: More bandwidth won't remove the queue
slides.body:
It changes how often it forms.
Traffic expands to fill it.

slides.title: Four or five classes
slides.body:
Not twelve.
Nobody reasons about twelve at *2am*.

slides.title: Shape to the rate you bought
slides.body:
Your router sees a gigabit.
The carrier polices at *200 Mbps*.

slides.title: What will you let wait?
slides.body:
Bandwidth is a purchase. Priority is a decision.
Only one requires somebody to say what matters least.
